description:
Approved by the user 2026-11-17 (relayed by the Optimize session: "proceed").

runtime/src/sched_core.rs:227-228, at the top of next_runnable's loop, reads the clock and drains expired timers on every scheduling decision, even when the timer wheel is empty (always on msg, fanin, ring: no after, no sleep). Ask the wheel first (it answers next_deadline()) and read the clock only when there is a deadline to compare against. No cached time.

Signal: GC's release profile of msg (develop a6ae5759d, sample 1 ms): clock_gettime under next_runnable 116 of 4,154 self samples (~3%) -> 0. A runtime test with a counting Clock source asserts zero reads across a timer-free run. Behaviour with timers pending is unchanged.
title: The scheduler reads the clock only when a timer is pending
